name: Beelzemon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] If this Digimon has [Beelzemon] or [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack for every 10 cards in your trash.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Impmon] in its name from your trash without paying the cost.
set_name: LM-06: Limited Card Pack Billion Bullet
